Name: Abinadab, Son of Jesse
Summary: Abinadab, Jesse's second son, was passed over by Samuel at the anointing and later served in Saul's army against the Philistines at Elah.
KeyStory: Abinadab was presented before Samuel and passed over, then fought at Elah beside his brothers.
RelatedPeople: Jesse; King David; Eliab, Son of Jesse; Shammah, Son of Jesse
LifeLesson: Being passed over is not the same as being rejected; every brother had his place in the battle.
